sources.label: Official White House Black Market size chart (Dresses tab, Regular Sizes; inches, converted at 2.54)

audit: Old URL whbm.com/content/pages/size-guide no longer loads; the official chart is at whitehouseblackmarket.com/store/page/size-chart (also opened from product-page 'Size Chart'). Used the Dresses 'Regular Sizes' chart because it is the one with bust, waist and hip together (Tops gives 'high hip'; bust and waist are identical to Dresses). Was 4 letter rows with UK/EU conversions WHBM does not publish; now 11 US numeric rows 00–18 with letters as altLabel (XS = US 0–2, M = US 8–10, XL = US 16–18). Inch originals in _in; the page's own cm view has rounding/typing errors (e.g. 24" waist shown as 58.42 cm), so cm were recomputed at exactly 2.54. Stored M bust 88 -> 92.7 (US 8) / 95.3 (US 10), hips 94 -> 99.1 / 101.6; L bust 94 -> 99.1 / 102.9, hips 100 -> 105.4 / 109.2. UK/EU removed (not published). Petite and long charts not included.
notes: US sizing (00–18; letters cover two sizes, e.g. M = US 8–10). American professional women's brand by Chico's FAS. Flattering, fitted silhouette. Petite, regular, and tall. Slim-fitting through torso — size up if between sizes. Strong US secondhand market, limited UK availability.
